definitions.explanation: To construct a building or structure.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{家|いえ}を{建|た}てる。
ここにビルが{建|た}てられた。
{夢|ゆめ}のマイホームを{建|た}てたい。
examples.english: I want to build my dream home.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {建|た}つ (intransitive, to be built). Pattern: Xを{建|た}てる (build X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed state. {建|た}てている = 'is building' or 'has built.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家|いえ}を{建|た}てる (build a house)
・ビルを{建|た}てる (construct a building)
・{建|た}て{替|か}える (rebuild)
・{一戸建|いっこだ}て (detached house—noun)

CONTRAST:
・{建|た}てる (transitive): (someone) builds X
・{建|た}つ (intransitive): X is built/stands

HOMOPHONE: Don't confuse with {立|た}てる (to stand something up), which has the same reading but different meaning.
・{建|た}てる (建): to build (structures)
・{立|た}てる (立): to stand up, erect (general)
